items:
NEW LISTING! Tucked away on a private boardwalk in the heart of Rosemary Beach, this professionally designed coastal retreat offers a rare combination of privacy, walkability and elevated luxury. It’s a Slice of Heaven! Just a quick stroll along a scenic wooden boardwalk brings you to the private sugar-white sand and unmistakable turquoise waters of the Gulf—yet when you return home, it feels like your own secluded oasis. With ample indoor and outdoor gathering spaces., including a backyard pool/hot tub! Tucked away just behind North Barrett Square, this home is also steps from downtown Rosemary.

Every inch of this home has been thoughtfully curated by a professional designer, with each room offering its own unique personality while maintaining a cohesive, high-end coastal aesthetic. Fresh whites, layered neutrals, custom finishes, and statement lighting create a space that feels both refined and welcoming—never cookie-cutter.

DESIGNED FOR GATHERING (AND LINGERING)
The newly renovated kitchen is the true heart of the home. Anchored by a generous island, it features custom cabinetry, quartzite countertops, premium appliances, two refrigerators, a spacious pantry and a dedicated coffee and beverage bar—perfect for slow mornings and effortless entertaining. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a light-filled dining and living area, where French doors and expansive windows blur the line between indoor and outdoor living. The living room is comfortable and spacious with seating for all! Step outside to the beautifully furnished front porch, a favorite spot for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or evening conversations after the sun sets. The views on Bourne Lane are what Rosemary is all about.

YOUR OWN HIDDEN COURTYARD OASIS
One of the home’s most coveted features is the private courtyard pool, completely enclosed by tall stucco walls for maximum serenity and seclusion. Whether you’re cooling off after the beach or enjoying a quiet afternoon poolside, this space feels like a boutique resort—without the crowds. The pool is a “spool”. A spool spa pool blends a small swimming pool with a hot tub. A first-floor full bathroom with a distinctive walk-in shower is conveniently accessible from both inside and outside, making post-beach rinses effortless. There is a $50/day fee to heat the spool.

THOUGHTFUL LUXURY ACROSS THREE LEVELS
Second Floor Sanctuary:
Primary Suite (Second Floor): A spacious retreat with king bed, private balcony access and a spa-like ensuite featuring a freestanding soaking tub, large walk-in shower, double vanities, and generous closet space.
Two Chic Guest Bedrooms (Second Floor): Each room with a king bed and balcony access and beautifully styled finishes, sharing a nearby bathroom with a walk-in shower.
Dedicated Full Service Laundry Area
Third Floor Escape:
A guest bedroom with a king bed
A dreamy kids’ retreat with four built-in twin beds, each with individual TVs and reading lights
A fourth bathroom with a tub/shower combo

This layout is ideal for multi-generational families or groups who want space to spread out—without sacrificing connection.

Unlike many properties, we provide laundry detergent, dish washing pods, nice hand soap at all sinks, trash bags, cleaning supplies, toilet paper, paper towels, beach towels, shampoo, conditioner and body wash. That makes shopping & packing easier for you!

ROSEMARY BEACH AT YOUR DOORSTEP
World-class amenities are just moments away, including:
3-minute walk to the private beach via scenic boardwalk with chair rental options
Close to Rosemary Beach Racquet Club & Fitness Center
Multiple community pools
The charming town center with boutique shopping, acclaimed dining, and nightly ambiance

WHY GUESTS LOVE THIS HOME
✔ Professionally designed—every room feels intentional and elevated
✔ Walk-to-private beach location via scenic boardwalk
✔ Private courtyard pool with full privacy. “Spool” can be a hot spa or pool.
✔ Multiple balconies, amazing front porch and outdoor living spaces
✔ Ideal for families, friends, and memorable group stays

This 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom Rosemary Beach home isn’t just a place to stay—it’s a place you’ll talk about long after your trip ends. A Slice of Heaven. Homes with this level of design, privacy and proximity to the private beach and town center are rarely available.

Our families have been spending time in Rosemary for over 15 years. We love to share our favorite restaurants, shopping and hidden gems with all of our guests. We are here to make your vacation as memorable as possible.

If you’re looking for a stay that feels special, elevated, and effortlessly coastal, this is the one. Don't miss out on the opportunity to be one of the first guests to enjoy this newly acquired and renovated property.

If you have a large group, check out our second property that backs up to this one. Just steps away, it sleeps another 13 guests. https://www.vrbo.com/3989926

​​​​​​​**THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY DURING PEAK SEASON (SPRING BREAK & SUMMER)
